Run scoped touched-path check over this task's own paths

verification_notes: deploy-headless.sh reported RESULT=landed_verify_clean (41 checks, 0 failures) on the first attempt. Both regression suites (test-orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh: 21/21; test-issue-record.sh: 27/27) passed with no CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE set, proving the deployed copies (not a stale pre-deploy snapshot). grep -rn '17-class\|17 classes\|17 class' returned empty across both agent-system/** and .claude/**. .claude/context/index.json's issue-log.md entry carries the regenerated '18-class seed taxonomy' summary and an auto-corrected line_count (326, via deploy-headless.sh's generate-context-line-counts.sh --write step). The scoped touched-path check (bash .claude/scripts/verify-touched.sh <12 explicit paths from this plan>) selected 31 suites (2 of the 12 paths fell to the OWED-NOT-PAID free-cost-class fallback, as the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral section anticipates) and reported 98 passed, 0 failed. Per this dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral section, the complete gate set is deferred to the orchestration close (Move 4) and is NOT independently re-run here.
